claim_boundary: Posthoc recorded-action consistency only; not label-independent replay, source-admission, serializer timing proof, or partner-visible-history proof.

method.recorded_action_role: Posthoc event description defining expected state relation; not independent timing evidence.
method.normalization: Casefold + whitespace collapse + at most two leading a/an/the tokens; no binding by substring, plural, synonym, or stemming.
method.alias_risk_exclusion: Exclude when target is a substring of another recorded room/possession label plus 's', reflecting historical desc_to_nodes risk; never use this to bind an entity. Other aliases/object IDs remain unknown.
method.multiplicity: Preserved; multiple exact appearances or alias risk remain ambiguous.
method.neighbor_rule: Same actor only. Previous anchor must have no physical command; any command between anchors excludes. Next anchor and turns between must have no physical command.
method.available_actions: Read for raw examples only, never used in timing predicate.
method.partner_result: Pickle has raw action and state arrays but no graph_copy; exact partner-facing result cannot be identified from this probe.
method.context_limit: Context text is retained in examples but not parsed as a state oracle.
